title: CI Verification — Test and Build Check
description: Inspect test and build configuration, execute verification, and summarize results.

tasks.title: Verify all imports resolve
command: import sample_app; print(f'sample_app v{sample_app.__version__} imported successfully')

tasks.title: Basic type consistency check
command: from sample_app import add, multiply, divide; assert isinstance(add(1,2), int); assert isinstance(multiply(3,4), int); assert isinstance(divide(10,2), float); print('Type checks passed')

tasks.title: Edge case verification
command: from sample_app import fibonacci, is_prime; assert fibonacci(0)==[]; assert fibonacci(1)==[0]; assert is_prime(2)==True; assert is_prime(1)==False; print('Boundary tests passed')
